data.gender_notes: Monicella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Monica, which means 'advisor' or 'monk'. The diminutive suffix -ella adds the meaning 'little one'. This name is often given to girls in honor of Saint Monica, a Christian saint known for her faithful prayers and guidance. The name Monicella carries the meaning “Advisor, Monk's little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Monicella usually hope their child will grow to embody advisor, monk's little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
